sentences.text: 1 withdrawn with liberty to renew the prayer for bail after receipt of DNA report vide order dated 14.08.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.32475/2023.
3 . A s per the prosecution story, on 28.09.2022, 17 years old prosecutrix's father lodged an FIR about missing of her daughter who was at home since 27.09.2022.
On 28.09.2022, when he came back home, he found her daughter missing.
When despite search she could not be traced, FIR was registered.
Almost after 8 days, prosecutrix was recovered.
She was pregnant.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed for commission of the aforesaid offence.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
At the time of commission of offence, prosecutrix was major and she was having love relation with him.
It is further submitted that prosecutrix's statement recorded at various occasions are self contradictory and she has improved her subsequent statements.
In her first 164, Cr.P.C. statement, she had not stated anything against the present applicant.
It is further submitted that the prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court.
Her evidence is contradictory.
Evidence of her parents regarding the age of the prosecutrix is contradictory.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed grant of bail and has submitted that at the time of commission of offence, prosecutrix was below 18 years of age.
Her date of birth is fortified by birth certificate.
It is submitted that in DNA report, applicant has been found the biological father of the fetus.
6 . In this case, DNA report is positive.
Applicant has been found the biological father of the offspring of the prosecutrix.
Prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court.
She has supported the prosecution story.
Therefore, having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case including the gravity of offence, I am not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, this third bail application too under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. is dismissed.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE ak Rammu Vishwakarma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113799548/
